In this paper, the authors introduce the Transformer model, which is a type of neural network architecture that uses self-attention mechanisms to process sequences of data. The self-attention mechanism allows the model to weigh the importance of different words in a sentence when generating an output, rather than relying on a fixed order of words. This allows the model to better capture the meaning and context of the input data. The paper also introduces the multi-head self-attention mechanism, which allows the model to attend to different aspects of the input data simultaneously.
